d: Akhilesh Yadav has taken the political battle straight to Yogi Adityanath’s stronghold, Gorakhpur, sending a clear message ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly Elections. From a massive 20-kilometre PDA Rath roadshow to his visit to the ancestral residence of former UP minister Hari Shankar Tiwari, Akhilesh is attempting to challenge Yogi on his home turf and consolidate Brahmin and PDA voters.
